observations: Photo 0: Back of a black smartphone with a vertical camera module on the top left, labeled 'CAMERA' in small text. A circular fingerprint sensor is centered below the camera. The back is heavily smudged and scratched.
Photo 1: Side view of the phone held in hand, showing a visible crack or damage along the left edge near the bottom. The power button and volume rocker are visible.
Photo 2: Front view of the phone held in hand, showing a cracked screen with multiple visible fractures, especially in the lower half. The screen is off, reflecting the person holding it.
All photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI KAMEEL'.

claims.evidence: The seller's words state the model, but no brand or model is visible in the photos. The camera module label 'CAMERA' is generic and does not confirm Tecno or Camon 15. The photos show a black phone with a vertical camera and fingerprint sensor, consistent with many models, but not uniquely Camon 15.

risks.risk: Screen is cracked and may not function properly or require replacement
risks.proof: A video showing the screen turning on and displaying content, or a close-up photo of the screen with the display active.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with a broken screen

risks.risk: Physical damage to the side casing may affect functionality or durability
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the damaged side edge showing depth of crack and whether internal components are exposed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as damaged, with reduced value

risks.risk: Phone may not power on or have internal faults
risks.proof: A video showing the phone powering on, booting up, and responding to touch.

risks.risk: Model is not actually Camon 15 as claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the phone's settings screen showing the model name, or a photo of the back with a visible brand logo or model name.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown model, with lower value

proof_requests: Photo of the phone's settings screen showing the model name.
Video of the phone powering on and displaying the home screen.
Close-up photo of the cracked screen with the display active.
Close-up photo of the damaged side edge showing the extent of the crack.
response.reason: The model cannot be confirmed from the photos alone, and critical functional and physical risks (cracked screen, side damage, unknown working condition) are unproven. Without proof of model and working condition, a reliable price cannot be assigned.
